title: It's Cheese
transcription:
It's Cheese

It's cheese, it's cheese, it's cheese
that makes the mice go round,
It's cheese, it's cheese, it's cheese
that makes the mice go round,
It's cheese, it's cheese, it's cheese
that makes the mice go round.
Chorus:
Oh, roll me o'er the ocean,
roll me o'er the sea,
roll me o'er the ocean
and the deep blue sea,
Oh, roll me o'er the ocean,
roll me o'er the sea,
roll me o'er the ocean
and the deep blue sea.

other verses:
...Mice that make the cats go round,
...Cats that make the dogs go round,
...Dogs that make the boys go round,
...Boys that make the girls go round,
...Girls that make the love go round,
...Love that makes the world go round,

after last verse and chorus:

Therefore!
It's cheese that makes the world go
round,
